ContractSize.name: Contract Size
ContractSize.definition: Quantity of product defined in the contract.

DeliveryType.name: Delivery Type
DeliveryType.definition: Indicates whether the contract is cash/physical/optional settled.

UnderlyingIdentification.name: Underlying Identification
UnderlyingIdentification.definition: Unique identifier for underlying or deliverable financial product on which final settlement price or equivalent is calculated.

PriceCurrency.name: Price Currency
PriceCurrency.definition: Specifies the currency of price of underlying.
